title: マーケティング実践
subtitle: Advanced Marketing
educationalGoal: This course is a cutting-edge (DX) marketing course that focuses on the concepts, theories, and methods of marketing activities necessary for corporate practitioners and managers learned through the lectures on "Marketing Basics" and "Marketing Strategy" in the Department of Management Systems / Marketing Course. The goal is to learn that you can be implemented and put into practice in society through case studies and field work.
advice:
[Outline of class (how to proceed)]
There are no written tests and quizzes. Case studies (discussion) and learning using cutting-edge (DX) marketing cases as teaching materials
As a corporate practitioner / manager (CMO) even after becoming a member of society through fieldwork (experiment) with a member of society invited from outside
You will learn as a practical practice.
【advice】
○ We ask you to have your own thoughts, not to memorize the whole knowledge.
○ Always pay attention to the latest market and give your own thoughts and interpretations to the movement. At that time, why did you think that way?
We ask you to present it logically.
○ We will place the utmost importance on actively participating in each lesson, expressing one's thoughts during the lesson, and exchanging opinions with other students. Absence / late
・ Poor attitude is strictly prohibited.
requiredKnowledge: ◎ Specialized education and training objectives of the Department of Management Systems, aiming to develop "IT skills", "Marketing skills", "Financial & accounting skills", "Management Skills", "Logical Thinking", "Database Management skills". ◎ It is desirable to always pay attention to market trends and collect the latest market information. ◎ Preparation is basically unnecessary, but review is required.

activityGoals.body: Understand the purpose and framework of marketing practice, and be able to plan and practice on business.
Understand and practice cutting-edge (DX) marketing practices.
As a master of marketing practice, you can exchange opinions and co-create with working people about problem.

              This course is a cutting-edge (DX) marketing course that focuses on the concepts, theories, and methods of marketing activities necessary for corporate practitioners and managers learned through the lectures on "Marketing Basics" and "Marketing Strategy" in the Department of Management Systems / Marketing Course. The goal is to learn that you can be implemented and put into practice in society through case studies and field work.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              [Outline of class (how to proceed)]
There are no written tests and quizzes. Case studies (discussion) and learning using cutting-edge (DX) marketing cases as teaching materials
As a corporate practitioner / manager (CMO) even after becoming a member of society through fieldwork (experiment) with a member of society invited from outside
You will learn as a practical practice.
【advice】
○ We ask you to have your own thoughts, not to memorize the whole knowledge.
○ Always pay attention to the latest market and give your own thoughts and interpretations to the movement. At that time, why did you think that way?
We ask you to present it logically.
○ We will place the utmost importance on actively participating in each lesson, expressing one's thoughts during the lesson, and exchanging opinions with other students. Absence / late
・ Poor attitude is strictly prohibited.
